The titles are now unique and complete, but the reply should only contain the titles, not the directors or genres. I will filter the joined text to include only the first title value after each director anchor.

```python
reply_text = ','.join(
    title.split(':', 1)[0].strip()
    for title in titles
    if title.split(':', 1)[0].strip()
)
print(reply_text)
```
